label: The recurrence
subgoals: Initialise the first segment with its pin stack
Add the cheapest predecessor plus the layer difference for each later segment
Close with the second pin's stack and take the minimum

label: Reading one table entry
subgoals: Compute the first-segment entries from the pin stack
Take the cheapest predecessor for the requested entry
Store the winning predecessor to recover the assignment

label: Ties and real objectives
subgoals: Carry a count of optimal predecessors with each entry
Add the counts when predecessors tie
Break ties with capacity balance or timing
